notablePrerequisites: Empowered Autogenerator has at least four charge counters on it.
description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {U} for each charge counter on it.
Activate Galvanic Key by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {U} for each charge counter on it.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Galvanic Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Galvanic Key by paying {2}.
Repeat from step 2.
